claims.claim: Root causes of Shadow-to-Master UPDATE/DELETE drops are: (1) DELETE WHERE _source_id = ? failing with SQLSTATE 42703 on Master tables where _source_id was dropped, coupled with binarySearchSplit discarding the entire single-task NATS batch; (2) Split-Brain _gpay_id between RunEvents (SHA-256) and Run (Sonyflake) breaking Segment B Recon/Heal; (3) Incremental Run() filtering only _gpay_id > lastGpayID which misses updated rows whose _gpay_id did not change; and (4) BatchBuffer grouping by signature before cross-signature deduplication.

The proposed solution in 09_tasks_solution_shadow_master_update_drop.md maps 1:1 to flaws F1 through F5: (F1) deleting on Master using conflictTarget dynamically parsed from binding.TransformSpec["pk"] via resolveConflictTarget and splitting single-task Events/SourceIDs payloads in binarySearchSplit; (F2) looking up Shadow _gpay_id in RunEvents and updating _gpay_id when conflictTarget != "_gpay_id"; (F3) scanning recently updated Shadow rows and triggering NATS transmute after ReconHealer; (F4) deduplicating by PrimaryKeyValue before signature grouping; and (F5) unioning all keys across records in bulkUpsertMaster.
claims.resolved: Verified 1:1 mapping in REF: /Users/trainguyen/Documents/work/agent/memory/workspaces/audit-shadow-master-update-drop-2026-10-20/09_tasks_solution_shadow_master_update_drop.md:20-44 covering F1, F2, F3, F4, F5.
